description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You would take damage from a Strike or effect while wielding a firearm.

Reduce the damage by an amount equal to twice your level. The firearm takes a permanent −1 penalty as though it had suffered a Cracked Barrel, cumulative with any it already has, repairable only at a proper workshop. A Good Gun may absorb this, and doing so is the only way one is ever damaged.
